summary: Validates that a named entrant carries both standings status values 10 and 6 at a rank-derived offset (entry + 4*v3 + 212), where v3 comes from sub_4C2990 on the standings sort buffer. Scans the first standings entry and then every active entry (ActiveEntityCounter loop), each time filling an 80-byte scene-name buffer via SceneNameLookupBySeason and comparing it against the input name with sub_566810 before reading the status dword; returns true only when both status values 10 and 6 were observed for the matching entrant.

operations.description: Initialize both status flags to false: v2 (status 10) = 0 and v11 (status 6) = 0.
sub_4C2990(&dword_7D2DB0) computes a rank-derived index v3 from the standings sort buffer; the index offsets the status dword read later.
LinkedListDereference(&dword_7D2DB0) followed by FixedOffsetReturn resolves the first/base standings entry pointer.
SceneNameLookupBySeason(v12, 80) fills the 80-byte scene/track name buffer used for the entrant-name comparison.
sub_566810(v12, this) compares the filled scene name against the input name; only matching entrants are status-evaluated.
First-entry status capture: when the dword at (baseEntry + 4*v3 + 212) equals 10 set v2 = 1, else set v11 to whether the same dword equals 6.
LinkedListDereference(&dword_7D2DB0) re-reads the sort buffer and ActiveEntityCounter(v8) produces the active-entry count for the scan guard.
The all-entries scan runs only while the active-entry counter is greater than 0.
do-while over v7 from 0 to activeCount-1, dereferencing the sort buffer each iteration and re-reading the active count as the loop condition.
ShortComputation_13a0(v7) returns the standings entry pointer for the current loop index v7.
Per-entry SceneNameLookupBySeason(v12, 80) plus sub_566810(v12, this) gate whether this entry's status is captured.
Per-entry status capture: set v2 = 1 when the dword at (entry(v7) + 4*v3 + 212) equals 10, and set v11 = 1 when it equals 6.
Return v2 && v11: true only when both status values 10 and 6 were observed for the matching entrant across the first entry and the full scan.
